job.purpose: ot_hgi_seq v2.4 RTL unchanged, hgi_seq_v2g floorplan 371.52x293.76 pd 0.5: GRT-0116 fix (v24 acb7765d9 route): 93% of overflow (19.2k of 20.6k gcell-units) sat on zero-capacity gcells over the two 1024x256 SRAMs (OBS M1-M4; under the M5 cap nothing crosses a macro), stacked mid-tile at x 61.8-236.5 with pins on BOTH faces (W: rd_out 256 + wd 136 + addr; E: wd 120 + 294 ties), so rd/wd and the FIFO logic on both sides crossed the macro wall (up to 145 H / 81 V nets per gcell row/column with capacity 0).
